* Specs / In the box: over-ear, closed back, ANC with transparency mode, up to 40 hours with ANC on, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, graphite, headphones + carry case + USB-C cable + 3.5mm cable

**Brackmoor Sound - Listing B**

* Availability: In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* Returns: 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method.
* Warranty: 1-year limited warranty.
